evidence: The thicknesses of the NbN films were measured by Rutherford backscattering spectrometry (RBS) of 2.0 MeV 4He+ ions. The nitrogen contents of the NbN films were analyzed both by backscattering spectrometry of 2.2 MeV protons and by nuclear resonance broadening (NRB) technique using a proton beam to excite the 429 keV resonance of the 1H(1s N, α)12C reaction. In a routine work, the film thicknesses were determined with a Link ISIS energy dispersive X-ray spectrometer (EDX) installed to a Zeiss DSM 962 scanning electron microscope (SEM). Crystal structure determination was carried out with a Philips MPD 1880 powder X-ray diffractometer using Cu Kα radiation. A standard four point probe technique was employed to measure the resistivities of the films.
